parties: TAS Technology Platforms Private Limited (investor) / RGD Dental Private Limited (investee)
headline: Legalics advises TAS on investment in RGD Dental: Counsel team led by Mahesh Kumar guided TAS Technology Platforms' equity investment into dental products distributor RGD Dental, which serves 5,000+ dentists across India.
sum: TAS Technology Platforms invests in RGD Dental, a regional dental and medical products distributor, to deploy a full-stack technology platform for product discovery, ordering and fulfilment across India and enter robotic dental ecosystem.
implication: Minority HealthTech investment in B2B distribution leverages legal counsel to structure technology-enabled platform deployment and robotic ecosystem integration-a structuring nuance as operational investment with technology overlays.
detail: RGD Dental currently serves 5,000+ dentists across 7,000+ SKUs as one of the region's most trusted dental and medical product distributors. TAS Technology Platforms' investment is aimed at deploying a full-stack technology platform to transform how dentists discover, order and receive products. The investment also supports RGD Dental's planned entry into the robotic dental ecosystem, signalling strategic expansion beyond distribution into advanced technologies. Legalics provided end-to-end transactional and legal support across all aspects of the deal.
